---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement for FishMe
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see added to FishMe.

## Use Case
Describe the use case for this feature. Why would it be useful? What problem would it solve?

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working. Include any relevant details about implementation.

## Alternatives
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered. Why did you choose this approach?

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request.

## Checklist
- [ ] I have searched for existing feature requests
- [ ] I have provided a descriptive title
- [ ] I have described the use case clearly
- [ ] I have proposed a solution
- [ ] I have considered alternatives
